title: The Martian Chronicles
author: Ray Bradbury
summary: A linked collection of stories follows human settlers to Mars, from the first failed expeditions to the towns that follow. Ray Bradbury writes it as a poetic meditation on loss, memory and what people carry to a new world.
readIf: you like lyrical, wistful science fiction made of short pieces more than a single plot.
skipIf: you want hard science or a single continuous storyline.

pairings.reason: Bradbury again, a more direct and urgent warning with the same poetic style.
Another melancholic story about humans meeting an alien world that will not behave as expected.
A gentle, elegiac look at what people save and remember after an old world ends.
